description: Shift an SRT or VTT subtitle timeline (content ≤2MiB): pass shift_ms (milliseconds; negative = earlier) or fps_src/fps_dst (frame-rate conversion, t' = round(t_ms × fps_src / fps_dst)), never both. The format is detected from the first line (WEBVTT = VTT). Everything except the two timestamps per cue is kept byte-for-byte: SRT comma/dot separators, VTT cue ids, cue settings, NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks and line endings; VTT comma millisecond separators are rewritten to dots and a BOM is stripped. Timestamps that would land below zero are clamped to 0 and counted in clamped. Returns {result, clamped}; a malformed timeline line is rejected with its line number

content.description: SRT or VTT subtitle text (≤2MiB); VTT is detected by a first line starting with WEBVTT

fps_dst.description: Target frame rate, 1–240 (requires fps_src); mutually exclusive with shift_ms

fps_src.description: Source frame rate, 1–240 (requires fps_dst); mutually exclusive with shift_ms

shift_ms.description: Shift every cue by this many milliseconds (negative = earlier); mutually exclusive with fps_src/fps_dst

name: shift_subtitles
